items.title: Three members of Iranian women's football team return home after seeking asylum
items.description: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke confirms that a trio of members of the Iranian women's football team, who were given humanitarian visas, chose to return home.

items.title: 'Almost unhinged': UAE minister tells ABC 'Iran attacks were surprise'
items.description: Iran's actions in attacking neighbouring countries were unprecedented, "almost unhinged" and irrational, according to a senior United Arab Emirates minister.

items.title: Live: Trump calls on China, Japan, UK to send ships to Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The president renewed his call for other nations to help secure the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Statement from Iran's new leader only fuels rumours about his whereabouts
items.description: Late last week, Iran's new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, broke his silence after days of intensifying rumours about his health and whereabouts, but it did little to put them to rest.

items.title: Iran's strikes on data centres show vulnerability of AI expansion
items.description: Iran struck three data centres in the Middle East, and has signalled that technology infrastructure will continue to be in the firing line.

items.title: Consequences of Iran war go beyond petrol pump for Labor
items.description: If the instability in the Middle East keeps energy markets volatile, the economic and political consequences will extend far beyond the petrol pump.

items.title: 'I don't believe him': Family and friends question killer's version of events
items.description: In 2020, a German backpacker strangled a Tasmanian sex worker, then fled with her mobile phone and cash. His version of events was accepted by an Australian court, which jailed him for manslaughter. Now, German authorities are re-examining the case.

items.title: The bikers transforming the lives of abused children, one ride at a time
items.description: BACA members accompany kids to court, stand guard outside their homes, and provide a sense of safety with burly presences and deeply rumbling motorbikes.

items.title: Floodwaters spread into Longreach outskirts with peak expected today
items.description: The swollen Thomson River has carried floodwaters closer to homes with levels forecast to continue rising.

items.title: Bankrupted and a string of legal fights: The man behind Trump Tower proposal
items.description: Inside the business and legal challenges David Young faced as he aspired to build Trump Tower on the Gold Coast.

items.title: Is Australia about to end its experiment with low unemployment?
items.description: If war in the Middle East sends global inflation surging, will Australia have to say goodbye to its experiment with low unemployment?

items.title: Why Yothu Yindi’s 'black Elvis' turned his back on wild rockstar life
items.description: Rockstar. Leader. Peacemaker. Witiyana Marika was riding the wave of international fame in the band Yothu Yindi when his dying father called him back to Arnhem Land.

items.title: Are we outsourcing our souls to artificial intelligence?
items.description: More people are turning to AI companions during personal crises, treating it as a confidante and even a way to speak to the dead. And while it helps some, it can also have devastating consequences, writes Compass presenter Benjamin Law.

items.title: The scam tricking Australians into downloading 'dreadful' malware
items.description: Scammers are targeting Australians with advertisements for 'free' tai chi classes to trick them into downloading malware capable of stealing money off their devices.

items.title: The man who forever changed Myf Warhurst's perspective on poo
items.description: When Myf Warhurst arrived in the sleepy town of Eldorado to film the latest episode of Back Roads, she didn't anticipate she would be touching compost made from human waste. But Hamish Skermer has that effect.

items.title: Righteo trivia hotshot, time to show us what you've got
items.description: One of these days, you might get lucky and ace this quiz. It's unlikely to be today. Let's play, HARD!

items.title: Meet the 25yo director at the helm of Miranda Otto's return to the stage
items.description: With two main-stage productions already under her belt in 2026, Margaret Thanos has cemented her place as a rising star of Australian theatre.

items.title: Trump and Iran trade threats over Kharg Island strikes
items.description: Iran responds to Trump's threats by saying any strike on their country's oil and energy infrastructure would lead to strikes on facilities owned by oil companies cooperating with the US.

items.title: Why has the US attacked Iran's Kharg Island?
items.description: Donald Trump says the US has "obliterated" Iran's military assets on the island, but stopped short of attacking other infrastructure.

items.title: From fuel price pain to mining woes, here's how the Iran war is hitting Australia's largest state
items.description: The war in the Middle East is beginning to have a tangible impact on the lives of Western Australians. Here's how.

items.title: NT requests ADF help with flood recovery as central Australia braces for rain
items.description: Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro is asking the federal government to deploy the ADF as floodwaters start to recede in parts of the Top End, while emergency services brace for more rain in central Australia.

items.title: 'Crisis' on the land as tens of thousands of rabbits are culled
items.description: Farmers say they are killing thousands of wild rabbits on their properties, but the problem is getting worse and they are seeking help.

items.title: Scientists create wheat that turns white bread into a higher-fibre food
items.description: Australian scientists have developed a wheat variety that dramatically boosts fibre in white bread and other flour-based foods.

items.title: McLaren 'kind of belong' behind F1 leaders, but Piastri keen to battle
items.description: Oscar Piastri has said McLaren's starting positions on the third row for today's Formula 1 Chinese Grand Prix are "about where we kind of belong".

items.title: Couple's side hustle uses grubs to turn food waste into high protein feed
items.description: A regional South Australian couple's fly larvae farm is using discarded produce to make a valuable food source.
